Immutable Diagram Revisions
|-- [M] Shared content boundary: Diagram + DiagramRevision
|   |-- Identity
|   |   |-- diagramId: stable service identity across revisions
|   |   |-- revisionId: identity of one immutable payload
|   |   |-- id: local canvas content key; revision: numeric content revision
|   |   `-- Revision record: id, diagramId, optional parentId, diagram, nodeRefs
|   |-- Content travels together
|   |   |-- Parsed ASCII content and structure
|   |   |-- Source context: optional binding, contentHash, mappings, evidence
|   |   `-- Optional highlights and jumps
|   |-- Public operations
|   |   |-- createDiagram / reviseDiagram / deriveDiagram -> immutable revision result
|   |   |-- submitDiagramEdit -> validated generated edit -> revision result
|   |   |-- diagramSource -> mapping/evidence queries
|   |   `-- Store API -> get, list, import, retain; convenience commands compose operations
|   |-- Internal dependencies
|   |   |-- Revision operations -> DiagramRevisionEditor -> construction / edit helpers
|   |   |-- Construction + validation -> content parser and node extraction
|   |   `-- Store -> revision registry -> validation + clone/freeze
|   `-- External boundary
|       |-- Canvas history supplies context -> local diagram id -> revision id bindings
|       `-- Canvas placement stays outside the content model
|-- [C] Produce a revision
|   |-- createDiagram(input)
|   |   `-- prepareCreate -> constructDiagram -> issueDiagramRevision
|   |       |-- Parse ASCII; generate diagram and revision identities
|   |       |-- Clone supplied metadata; validate constructed diagram
|   |       `-- Assign logical node refs; deep-freeze revision record; validate
|   |-- reviseDiagram(base, edit)
|   |   `-- prepareEdit against the supplied base
|   |       |-- source-mappings
|   |       |   |-- expectedContentHash must match base ASCII hash
|   |       |   `-- Clone new mappings/evidence; optionally replace binding; validate
|   |       |-- patch / patches
|   |       |   |-- patchDiagramRanges -> edited diagram + node map + optional line map
|   |       |   |-- Explicit continuity claims -> checked node map; rebase highlights
|   |       |   `-- Batch retainMappings -> retain source mappings; otherwise accept supplied mappings
|   |       |-- replace
|   |       |   |-- Construct content at base numeric revision + 1
|   |       |   |-- Establish node correspondence; rebase prior jumps and highlights
|   |       |   `-- Optionally retain source mappings; validate
|   |       |-- jumps / highlights -> validate supplied metadata
|   |       `-- Prepared result
|   |           |-- Same diagram object as base -> return base revision
|   |           `-- Otherwise -> preserve diagramId; mint revisionId; issue with parentId = base.id
|   |-- deriveDiagram(base, input, refs, sources)
|   |   |-- Every identity source must belong to the base diagramId
|   |   |-- Prepare replacement; check continuity claims that refer to base nodes
|   |   `-- Requested refs must exist in sources and identify distinct output nodes
|   |       `-- Issue revision with explicit identities and parentId = base.id
|   `-- submitDiagramEdit(request, candidate, base, correspondence)
|       |-- Reject missing/mismatched requested base or wrong local diagram id
|       |-- New diagrams cannot specify replacementRanges
|       |-- Choose context: base -> request context -> constructed placeholder
|       |   `-- validateGeneratedDiagramEdit -> combine continuity claims and source context
|       |-- Base + requested edit ranges
|       |   |-- Preserve structure kind; scopedReplacements -> patches + output ranges
|       |   |-- Shift mappings outside edited ranges; admit generated mappings inside output ranges
|       |   `-- reviseDiagram(patches) -> result includes replacementRanges
|       `-- Otherwise -> replace requested base revision, or create at numeric revision 0
|-- [D] Valid payload and node continuity depend on explicit evidence
|   |-- Canonical content check
|   |   `-- ASCII + local id:numeric revision + structure kind + parser version
|   |       `-- buildDiagramContent -> must equal supplied content
|   |-- Source context check
|   |   |-- ASCII -> SHA-256 -> must equal sourceContext.contentHash
|   |   |-- Optional binding -> valid source/repository identity, absolute corpus root,
|   |   |   `-- compatible domain profile and corpus kind
|   |   `-- Mapping entityId + sourceRangeIndex -> evidence entity -> source range
|   |       |-- Optional mapping sourceRangeId must match the range id
|   |       |-- Evidence key must match entry id; source ids must agree when present
|   |       `-- Relative non-traversing path + valid line interval + matching originalLines
|   |-- Logical node refs for an issued revision
|   |   |-- Parsed output nodes + old-node -> new-node correspondence + base.nodeRefs
|   |   `-- For each output node, choose
|   |       |-- Explicit derived identity, else
|   |       |-- Corresponding base node's logical ref, else
|   |       `-- Fresh node UUID
|   |-- Continuity constraints
|   |   |-- correspondingNodes infers matches only when ASCII and structure kind are unchanged
|   |   |   `-- Match exact line, columns and label; heuristic previews do not establish anchors
|   |   `-- Explicit ref -> output line claim
|   |       |-- Must identify an old logical ref and exactly one output node
|   |       |-- Must not contradict inferred unchanged-node correspondence
|   |       `-- Multiple old identities cannot claim one output node
|   `-- Source queries reuse the mapping/evidence join
|       |-- Selection -> selected mappings -> entity + range + binding
|       `-- Search -> entity id / label / path / symbol -> matching joined entries
`-- [O] Retain immutable records; publish bindings separately
    |-- Domain operations create frozen revisions without storing or publishing them
    |-- retainDiagramRevision(result)
    |   `-- import -> check every parsed node has a nonempty, unique logical ref
    |       `-- Registry register -> return canonical stored revision in result
    |-- Registry owns records, serialized signatures and pending-validation ids
    |   |-- Revision id and diagramId must agree with the embedded diagram
    |   |-- New record -> validate -> structuredClone -> deepFreeze -> retain
    |   |-- Existing revision id
    |   |   |-- Same serialized record -> reuse retained record
    |   |   `-- Different serialized record -> reject: Diagram revision is immutable
    |   `-- Restore through validated storage/history adapters
    |       |-- Clone/freeze and retain now; defer content parsing/validation
    |       `-- First get -> validate diagram and node refs -> clear pending flag
    |-- resolve(contextId, localDiagramId)
    |   |-- Follow supplied binding to revision; reject unknown/mismatched diagram
    |   |-- Translate node ids, parent/child ids and active jump anchors to logical refs
    |   `-- Return a structured-cloned view; retained revision payload stays internal
    |-- merge(baseline, current, proposed)
    |   |-- Any baseline/current binding change -> MERGE_REQUIRED
    |   `-- Otherwise -> copy proposed bindings; automatic three-way merge is absent
    `-- Durable adapters must flush retained revisions before publishing bindings
